about_the_game:
The party game where winning mostly means making others fall

Animal Falling is a chaotic multiplayer party game that mixes obstacle racing, player-placed traps, and creative sabotage in a colorful cartoon world ruled by chaos.

Lead your cute little aniballs to victory while dodging your friends’ traps… or your own.

Physically (and mentally) unstable animals

In Animal Falling, gravity is your worst enemy. And it brought friends.

  • Roll, slide, fall: Your chubby aniballs tumble and bounce in wildly unpredictable ways.

  • Treacherous surfaces: Tornadoes that sweep you away, icy platforms that steal control… Every turn is a new opportunity to fail spectacularly.

Traps with a mind of their own

Traps are the heart of the game.
Discover a wide variety of tools designed to drive your friends crazy:

🔨 Spinning hammers that never stop
🪨 Anvils that fall at the worst possible moment.
🥕 Amazingly unpredictable electric carrots.
🌀 Shady moving platforms you should never trust.

Every trap can be combined.
Every setup can backfire.
Every round tells a different story.

Biomes for every taste (and every fall)

🏝️ Tropical Island : Perfect for sending your friends for an unexpected dip in crystal-clear water.

🗻 Snowy Mountain : Ideal for sliding on ice, getting stuck in deep snow, or taking a rock straight to the face.

Play however you want (but play dirty)

  • Local & online multiplayer: Play with up to 4 players in split-screen or up to 6 players online.
    The perfect game to spice up game nights… or ruin family dinners.

  • Customization & fancy hats: Dress up your aniball in ridiculous accessories to stay stylish even while flying off the map.

Wishlist the game on Steam

If you enjoy:

  • chaotic party games,

  • friendly betrayal,

  • games that don’t take themselves too seriously...

Add Animal Falling to your wishlist. It helps the game a lot.
detailed_description:
1. Place your traps

Strategically place your traps: activate crossbows, turn on giant fans, or plant electric carrots exactly where your rivals least expect them.

The pettier the move, the better.


2. Start the race

The gates open. The aniballs are released.

Roll, bounce, and slide through a minefield you helped create yourself. Just don’t be surprised if your own evil genius backfires at the very first turn.


3. Enjoy the fall

Watching your best friend fly off the map two inches from the finish line brings a deep, guilty laugh that only pure betrayal can inspire.

The frustration is real. The chaos is total. And suddenly, there’s only one thing you want to do: 

Start another match and get revenge on that treacherous rabbit.
